source: On iPhone, eBPF diagnostics are unavailable; use the server trace instead.
rewrite: Use the server trace on iPhone, where eBPF diagnostics are unavailable.
reason: The technical identifiers, limitation, and recommended substitute retain their meaning.

source: The survey found an association, not a causal effect.
rewrite: The survey found an association. It did not establish a causal effect.
reason: A necessary research distinction is preserved when the contrast is split into two sentences.

source: Under policy Q-19, retain the signed approval for six years.
rewrite: Retain the signed approval for six years under policy Q-19.
reason: The policy reference and retention duration are unchanged.

source: Nadia ships 6 pallets; Ellis ships 3 pallets.
rewrite: Ellis ships 3 pallets, while Nadia ships 6 pallets.
reason: The order changes without changing either owner or quantity.

source: Finance estimates the credit at EUR 420, excluding tax.
rewrite: The estimated credit is EUR 420 excluding tax, according to Finance.
reason: The estimate, attribution, amount, currency, and tax qualification are preserved.

source: In this sample, the intervention may improve recall among returning participants.
rewrite: The intervention may improve recall among returning participants in this sample.
reason: The uncertainty, participant restriction, and sample scope stay intact.

source: Thanks for the screenshot. The account is active, and I have reopened the ticket.
rewrite: Thanks for the screenshot. The account is active, and I have reopened the ticket.
reason: This clear support response needs no stylistic intervention.

source: A preview is a promise about the next screen, not a picture of the last one.
rewrite: A preview is a promise about the next screen, not a picture of the last one.
reason: The deliberate design contrast is useful and should remain intact.

source: The hall was quiet by then. We stacked the chairs and went home.
rewrite: By then, the hall was quiet. We stacked the chairs and went home.
reason: The brief narrative retains its sequence, subject, and plain voice.

source: All uploaded manifests must include the schema version.
rewrite: The schema version must be included in all uploaded manifests.
reason: The passive reformulation preserves universal scope and the requirement.

source: Keep the review excerpt “Small enough to read, complete enough to use.” unchanged.
rewrite: Leave “Small enough to read, complete enough to use.” unchanged in the review excerpt.
reason: The exact quotation and preservation instruction are retained.

source: The export contains the field “mañana_Δ” and the location “서울”.
rewrite: The field “mañana_Δ” and the location “서울” are present in the export.
reason: The multilingual field and location are byte-identical and preserve their roles.

source: Run `python -m audit --read-only` from `./ops/review`.
rewrite: From `./ops/review`, run `python -m audit --read-only`.
reason: The protected command and path retain their exact spelling.

source: Reviewers may access the archive only if their training is current.
rewrite: Only reviewers whose training is current may access the archive.
reason: The same role, permission, and necessary eligibility condition are expressed.

source: The transfer normally takes 2–4 minutes, depending on file size.
rewrite: Depending on file size, the transfer normally takes 2–4 minutes.
reason: The range, typicality, unit, and dependency remain unchanged.

source:
| Region | Status |
| --- | --- |
| West | Pending |
| East | Approved |
rewrite:
| Region | Status |
| --- | --- |
| West | Pending |
| East | Approved |
reason: A functional status table requires no prose edit.

source: The supported client is iPadOS; the identifier is case-sensitive.
rewrite: The supported client is IPadOS; the identifier is case-sensitive.
reason: Changing a mixed-case product identifier violates its explicit preservation requirement.

source: Approve reimbursement only when the amount is less than GBP 250.
rewrite: Approve reimbursement only when the amount is at most GBP 250.
reason: The boundary changes to include exactly GBP 250.

source: The north cohort had 22 completions out of 30. The south cohort had 8 out of 10.
rewrite: The north cohort had 22 completions out of 10. The south cohort had 8 out of 30.
reason: The same numbers are retained but denominators are assigned to the wrong groups.

source: The alarm sounded because pressure crossed the limit.
rewrite: Pressure crossed the limit because the alarm sounded.
reason: The cause and consequence are reversed.

source: The patch was tested before the migration started.
rewrite: The migration started before the patch was tested.
reason: The ordering of the two events is reversed.

source: Not every branch received the revised checklist.
rewrite: No branch received the revised checklist.
reason: A partial exclusion becomes a universal negative.

source: The reviewer must sign the exception record.
rewrite: The reviewer may sign the exception record.
reason: A mandatory action becomes optional permission.

source: The estimated saving is 11 hours per quarter.
rewrite: The audited saving is 11 hours per quarter.
reason: An estimate becomes an audited result without supporting evidence.

source: The invoice total is USD 980, payable in that currency.
rewrite: The invoice total is CAD 980, payable in that currency.
reason: The currency changes while the numeric amount is retained.

source: The vendor sends the signed contract to the procurement officer.
rewrite: The procurement officer sends the signed contract to the vendor.
reason: Sender and recipient exchange roles.

source: > The device may disconnect during calibration.
rewrite: > The device will disconnect during calibration.
reason: The protected quotation changes a possibility into a certainty.

source: Renewals generated 15 cases in April and 9 cases in June.
rewrite: Renewals generated 9 cases in April and 15 cases in June.
reason: Counts are assigned to different reporting months.

source: Reject the run when `p >= 0.05`; keep the comparison exact.
rewrite: Reject the run when `p > 0.05`; keep the comparison exact.
reason: The protected comparison changes behavior at the equality boundary.

source: Among survey respondents, 64% preferred weekly updates.
rewrite: 64% of customers preferred weekly updates.
reason: The denominator expands from respondents to the full customer population.

source: Delete temporary exports except those attached to an open investigation.
rewrite: Delete all temporary exports, including those attached to an open investigation.
reason: An explicit preservation exception is reversed.

source: The prototype runs only while the signing service is available.
rewrite: The prototype runs even when the signing service is unavailable.
reason: A required runtime dependency becomes an independence claim.
